steps.name: stub-backend-and-sign-in
steps.eval: (() => { const realFetch = window.fetch.bind(window); const admin = { id:'admin1', email:'admin@sofa.sg', name:'Admin', role:'admin', createdAt:'2026-01-01' }; const jane = { id:'u2', email:'jane@sofa.sg', name:'Jane Tan', role:'user', createdAt:'2026-02-01' }; const json = (o,st=200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(o), { status: st, headers: { 'Content-Type':'application/json' } }); window.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input.url; const method = (init && init.method ? init.method : 'GET').toUpperCase(); if (url.includes('/api/auth/me')) return json({ user: admin }); if (url.includes('/api/admin/users') && method === 'GET') return json({ users: [admin, jane] }); if (url.includes('/api/admin/users/') && method === 'PATCH') return json({ user: jane }); if (url.includes('/api/flags')) return json({ overrides: {} }); return realFetch(input, init); }; window.__store.setState({ currentUser: { id:'admin1', name:'Admin', role:'admin' }, authIsBackend: true }); window.__store.getState().setLoginOpen(true); })()
